Ajay K.: quick heads-up — small repro for a bundler interop bug affecting our JS SDK on edge.
Ajay K.: repo (internal): https://github.com/redwood-internal/repro-esbuild-edge-auth
Ajay K.: short: build with esbuild/vite in CJS mode -> deploy to edge runtime -> calls 401 even when token present. local esm build works.
Maria L.: is this specific to esbuild, or any cjs output?
Ajay K.: only reproduced when output is cjs (esbuild format: 'cjs' or vite lib formats: ['cjs']). webpack/rollup producing pure esm seems fine.
Ben R.: paste the error you saw?
Ajay K.: runtime log: 
ERROR: Request failed: 401 Unauthorized
TypeError: sdk.generate is not a function
    at file:///workspace/dist/index.js:120:18
Ajay K.: looks like default vs named export shape changed, so callers expecting default get an object wrapper instead.
Olivia: esbuild's cjs transform often wraps exports differently. could also be our package entrypoints confusing the resolver in the edge deployer.
Samir: also check if the bundler inlines process.env or strips the auth wrapper. seen headers dropped by edge adapters before.
Ajay K.: minimal repro steps:
1) git clone https://github.com/redwood-internal/repro-esbuild-edge-auth && cd repro-esbuild-edge-auth
2) npm i
3) npm run build:esm   # vite -> formats: ['es'] -> works
   npm run build:cjs   # vite/esbuild -> formats: ['cjs'] -> fails on edge
4) deploy to edge or run deno task start:edge
5) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://edge.local/_gen -> 401 + TypeError

Ajay K.: vite config snippet that reproduces it:
```js
// vite.config.js
export default {
  build: {
    lib: { entry: 'src/index.ts', formats: ['cjs'] },
    commonjsOptions: { transformMixedEsModules: true },
    target: 'es2020'
  }
}
```

Maria L.: typings impact? TS users hit mismatched types?
Ben R.: yes. TS consumers importing default see wrong shape when runtime uses cjs. esModuleInterop masks it locally but breaks strict projects.
Olivia: short-term workaround?
Ajay K.: force ESM bundle (formats: ['es']) or add small interop shim at package entry: `module.exports = exports.default ? exports.default : exports` — ugly but works.
Samir: CI: i added a smoke test that builds both formats and runs an edge emulator; can push to repro.
ci-bot: build #4893 (esbuild-edge-smoke) finished — artifacts at https://artifacts.internal/repro/4893/
Maria L.: action items:
- Ben: add interop wrapper to SDK entrypoint and publish canary.
- Olivia: update onboarding sample app docs to prefer ESM by default and warn about commonjsOptions.transformMixedEsModules.
- Ajay: add the repro and CI job to devex docs so teams can reproduce locally.
Samir: +1 to hooking the edge runner into SDK PRs so we catch this in CI.
Ajay K.: i'll open the PR with repro + failing job and link the patch once Ben has a canary. :thumbsup:
